title: At 25:00, in Akasaka Gets Anime
content: At 25:00, in Akasaka boys’ love manga by Hiroko Natsuno is getting an anime adaptation. A teaser visual and trailer have also been unveiled and the main cast will reprise their roles from the drama CDs, with Soma Saito voicing Yuki Shirasaki and Takuya Sato voicing Asami Hayama. The anime premieres in 2027.
author: Anime Corner

title: 'Kakunaru Ue wa' Unveils Additional Cast, Theme Songs, Second Promo
content: The official website of the Kakunaru Ue wa ( Now That We Draw ) television anime unveiled additional cast, a key visual (pictured), the theme songs, and second promotional video on Wednesday.
author: MyAnimeList

title: 'At 25:00, in Akasaka' Boys-Love Manga Gets TV Anime in 2027
content: Pony Canyon announced on Wednesday the television anime adaptation of Hiroko Natsuno 's At 25:00, in Akasaka ( 25-Ji, Akasaka de ) boys-love manga, and presented the anime's teaser trailer, teaser visual, and main cast members. The anime will premiere in 2027 on the TBS channel.
author: ANN

title: 'Now That We Draw' Anime's New Video Unveils More Cast, Ending Song Artist, January 8 Debut
content: The official website for the television anime of Kyū Takahata and Yūji Kaba 's Now That We Draw ( Kakunaru Ue wa ) manga unveiled on Wednesday the anime's main promotional video, main visual, new cast member, and January 8 premiere.
author: ANN

title: Manga '25-ji, Akasaka de' Gets TV Anime in 2027
content: An official website opened for a television anime adaptation of Hiroko Natsuno 's 25-ji, Akasaka de ( At 25:00 in Akasaka ) web manga on Wednesday, revealing the main cast, teaser visual (pictured), and teaser promotional video. The anime will premiere on TBS in 2027.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Migratory Birds & Snail TV Anime Debuts Next Summer
content: The wraparound jacket band on Makoto Takatsu 's seventh compiled Wataridori to Katatsumuri ( Migratory birds & Snail ) manga volume announced that the television anime of the manga will premiere in summer 2027. The manga's latest volume shipped on Wednesday.
author: ANN

title: 'Youchien Wars' Unveils Staff, Main Promo, Opening Theme
content: The official website for the Youchien Wars ( Kindergarten Wars ) revealed additional staff, opening theme, main visual (pictured), and main promotional video on Wednesday. The anime series adapting You Chiba 's action comedy manga will air on TV Tokyo network stations in April 2027.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Kindergarten Wars Anime's Video Reveals More Staff, ado's Opening Song, April Debut
content: Bandai Namco Filmworks unveiled the first full promotional video and main visual for the television anime of Yū Chiba 's Kindergarten WARS ( Yōchien Wars ) manga on Wednesday. The video announces more staff members and the April premiere for the anime, and also announces and previews the anime's opening theme song…

title: 'Himekishi-sama no Himo' Reveals Supporting Cast, Second Promo
content: The official website for the Himekishi-sama no Himo ( The Kept Man of the Princess Knight ) television anime adaptation revealed supporting cast and second promotional video on Wednesday.

title: The Kept Man of the Princess Knight Anime's New Video Reveals More Cast, Ending Song, January 3 Debut
content: Kadokawa revealed a new promotional video, additional cast members, and January 3 premiere for the television anime of Toru Shirogame's The Kept Man of the Princess Knight ( Himekishi-sama no Himo ) light novel series on Wednesday.
